wpml_cf_preferences.description: 1 in the common post/block context ("copy" — non-translatable). 2 is also valid: on ACF Options Pages, ACFML permanently locks a copy-flagged (1) field to its default-language value (no post duplication to copy from), so options-page gallery fields are documented (tailwind-base wordpress/gutenberg.md, wordpress/wpml.md) to use 2 instead. The schema has no per-location context to enforce 1-only-outside-options-pages, so both canonical values are accepted here.
